notes.primary_arm_definition: nested-CV composite: fold i scored with the select mode that won on folds != i (SPEC D8); per-fold winners in nested_cv
notes.matched_subset: cells where prfba_nestedcv and picrust2 both predicted
notes.population_view: a blank f1 cell counts as 0.0; empty-truth and min_align-dropped cells are excluded from every denominator for every arm

primary_claim.gate: a run whose primary contrast has no CI cannot state the claim either way; 'indeterminate_no_ci' is NOT 'the effect is below the SESOI'

derivation.spec: SPEC 11.2: 60 PICRUSt2 forced (10 folds x 2 domains x 3 densities) + 10 nsti + 30 prFBA fold + 10 prFBA forced-answer, each exactly once

headline.sentence: leave-genus-out, 7175 species-dereplicated reference genomes (median per fold at density 1.0), coverage 0.893: prfba_nestedcv population EC-F1 0.6867 vs picrust2 0.7787, delta -0.092 (95% CI [-0.1073, -0.0812], cluster bootstrap over 2376 holdout groups, n_eff 6716); skill score vs constant/clade-max floor-ceiling 0.2827; SESOI 0.02 exceeded.
